text:
lex: heads up — after the kernel-selector tweak that prefers large-window kernels for short seqs, i'm seeing +3-8ms p50 on ~50-200 token host-side requests. not huge but visible in our tail telemetry.
amira: ugh. saw that in the nightly too. do you have a flamegraph or perf counter? where's the extra time bleeding (parse, tokenize, write)?
dalton: attaching quick snippet from perf on a repro node (trimmed):
```
[flame] host_parse() -> tokenize() -> writev()
- host_parse: 4.2ms (was 1.1ms)
- tokenize: 0.9ms (stable)
- writev: 1.8ms (was 1.0ms)
```
looks like parse + write path increased. possibly more fragments being emitted.
misha: noticed KV cache eviction rate jumped around the same deploy window. trace shows more small requests missing kv cache because the preparse path now splits earlier which prevents prefix coalescing. kvcache hit drops ~6%.
lex: that matches. kernel selector changed the sequence-length bucketing; it shifted a bunch of requests into a path that triggers earlier chunking in the preparse shim. so two things: different kernel + different framing -> worse host overhead.
amira: can we tweak batching heuristics to prefer keeping small seqs on the slim preparse path? maybe a fast-fail to old kernel for <128 tokens?
dalton: quick patch i tried locally: set kernel_selector.threshold_small=128 and keep preparse.coalesce=true for those buckets. perf locally: host_parse back to ~1.2ms, writev down to 1.0ms. pushed a canary to vhost-1 for the next hour.
commands:
```
kubectl apply -f canary-config.yaml --context=canary
# config snippets
"kernel_selector.threshold_small":128
"preparse.coalesce":true
```
deploy-bot: Canary config applied to fleet vhost-1 (canary-ops). roll id c-2026-0423-1 :rocket:
misha: after canary sampling (2000 reqs) kvcache hit recovered +5%, evictions back to baseline. tail p95 host latency improved ~6ms on that cohort.
lex: good. plan: roll small-kernel threshold change to canary tier, add a regression test in perf-suite (micro-host-path <256 tokens) and add telemetry alert for kvcache hit delta > 3%. also add an integration test for preparse.coalesce = false -> true transition to avoid future accidental flips.
amira: +1. i'll file the perf-suite ticket and include the flame graphs and the config diffs. can we add a short note in the release changelog about kernel-selector behavioral change so SRE knows the vector?
dalton: filing PR for canary-to-prod rollback plan if we see any throughput regressions. tl;dr: revert kernel-selector change until we have a smoother bucket migration, or keep the kernel change but force preparse.coalesce on small buckets.
lex: thanks. action items -> dalton: PR with config, amira: perf-suite ticket & changelog note, misha: add kvcache alert. i'll monitor canary for 2hrs then propose rollout. :thumbsup:
